content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the removal of a crucial check in the `ZooKeeperInstance` class that validated whether a provided instance name existed in Zookeeper when creating a new instance. Prior to the introduction of the client configuration, the `getInstanceID()` method was called during the instantiation of `ZooKeeperInstance`, which would throw a `RuntimeException` if the instance name did not exist. With the change to client configuration, this validation was omitted, allowing invalid instance names to be passed without raising any errors, leading to potential misconfigurations and runtime exceptions later in the application. The patch reinstates this validation to ensure that only valid instance names are accepted during the creation of `ZooKeeperInstance`.
